principles.typography: High contrast. Massive bold figures for primary data; small, muted, letter-spaced labels for secondary data.
principles.cards: Flat, borderless or subtly elevated surfaces with 16-24dp radii. Prefer clean rows with a crisp leading icon, clear label, trailing value/chevron over grids of boxes.
principles.color: Deep monochromatic dark/light canvas. Vibrancy reserved strictly for accents, success states and critical actions. Status color is never the only signal.
principles.copy: Hyper-clear, action-oriented, jargon-free. Short direct labels: 'Sent', 'Kept', 'Left' - not accounting terms.

screens.name: Dashboard
decisions: 2026-11-07 - Q1 A: Verdict-first hierarchy. One dominant 'Kept' hero, one muted caption, one 'This month' row; allocation detail folds under it.
2026-11-07 - Q2 A: Quick action grid removed. Bottom navigation stays; add one prominent 'Add expense' action.
2026-11-07 - Q3 A: Budgets render as a full-width row list (status dot, name, thin progress bar, 'amount left', chevron) with a 'See all' action; tapping a row opens a detail sheet.
2026-11-07 - Q4 A: Hero label is 'Kept', with the caption 'this month'. The month navigator already carries the month.
2026-11-07 - Q5 A: One full-width 'Add expense' button directly under the hero. No floating action button.
2026-11-07 - Q6 A: Secondary content is rows only - Savings, Next step, Analytics. No mini charts or Savings card on the dashboard.
screens.notes: Approved 2026-11-07. Design direction locked (1A/2A/3A/4A/5A/6A). This screen is the reference implementation for the Revolut alignment of the remaining screens.

screens.name: Settings
decisions: 2026-11-07 - Q1 A: Goal-based hub. Replace the long card stack with a current-context header plus six goal-based rows (Budgeting, Sharing, Security, Appearance, Help & learning, Advanced). Dense editors move into focused sub-screens or sheets.

2026-11-07 - Q2 A: One current-context row. Avatar, profile name, active space and currency with a Switch chevron opening a profile/space sheet; remove the duplicate avatar grid and the separate Profiles card.

2026-11-07 - Q3 A: Summary rows with drill-downs. Appearance becomes one value row opening a sheet with theme choices and font list; Security becomes one status row opening a dedicated security screen, with the lock switch kept inline.
screens.notes: Approved 2026-11-07. The Settings hub becomes the reference for goal-based settings navigation. All existing settings, routes, keys and write paths must remain reachable; financial logic is untouched.
